variants.title: Continuous-wave NMR of fluorine-19 in PTFE (illustrative line width)
variants.sample: PTFE (19F), gamma = 0.941 x proton (Xi from memory; unsourced / illustrative)
variants.method: fixed RF frequency, field sweep, lock-in derivative
variants.note: Fluorine-19 resonates at 94 % of the proton field-frequency ratio and a solid sample has a broader line than a liquid.

source.title: IUPAC NMR frequency ratios (Xi); the 19F value is quoted from memory (unsourced / illustrative)

variants.title: CW NMR of protons in water with a paramagnetic salt
variants.sample: Water with a paramagnetic salt (1H), broad line (unsourced / illustrative)
variants.method: fixed RF frequency, field sweep, lock-in derivative
variants.note: The salt shortens relaxation and broadens the line; the resonance field is unchanged.

source.title: Slichter, Principles of Magnetic Resonance; CODATA proton gamma
